THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:7368  CRL.P No. 100817 of 2023  ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners filed memo.

Memo reads as under:
" Herein the Advocate for the petitioner begs to submit as under:
That in the above case, the petitioners have challenged the FIR and complaint filed by the respondent No.1 with instigation of respondent No.2 bearing Gangavati Crime No.35/2023 pending on the file of Prl. Civil Judge(Sn.Dn.) and CJM Gangavati after filling the above petition the I O has submitted that charge sheet against the petitioner in the above crime, therefore, the petitioners may kindly be permitted to withdraw the petition and liberty may kindly reserve for challenging the charge sheet filed in Gangavati Crime No.35/2023 and liberty to file the fresh petition, in the interest of justice and equity."
3. In view of the memo, petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
